I, Nalaka Jude Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands, do hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the land described below is needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

The allotment of below mentioned land (Lot No. A) in total extent of about 1.0117 Hectare depicted in the Advance Tracing No. KA/DSO/2019/680 dated 22.12.2020 prepared by the Surveyor General, situated in the Village of Raddegoda and Grama Niladhari Division No: 644C, Raddegoda in the Divisional Secretary's division of Millaniya in Kaluthara District of Western Province and boundaries are below :

01. Lot ‘A’ – Maragahalandewatta – Extent: 1.0117 Hectare North: Claimant not found Hinatideniyakumbura, Maragahalande watta claimed by Angage Piyasena Perera, Claimant not found Maragahalande watta, Maragahalande

watta claimed by Sujee Premakumara; East: Maragahalande watta claimed by Angage Piyasena Perera, Claimant not found Maragahalande watta, Maragahalande watta claimed by Sujee Premakumara, Claimant not found Maragahalande watta and Road (Pradeshiya Sabha); South: Road (Pradeshiya Sabha) and Maragahalande watta claimed by Chalat Sandanayaka, Loku Liyanage Muditha Kumara Alwis and Others; West: Maragahalande watta claimed by Chalat Sandanayaka, Loku Liyanage Muditha Kumara Alwis and others and Claimant not found Hinatideniyakumbura.
Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands.
My No.: 4-3/18/2019/WS/474.Ministry of Tourism and Lands,“Mihikatha Medura”, Rajamalwatta Avenue, Battaramulla.31st August 2023.
